newsitem.title: GREECE: SPYROU AGRICULTURE SAYS H1 PRETAX UP 24.1PCT.
newsitem.headline: SPYROU AGRICULTURE SAYS H1 PRETAX UP 24.1PCT.

text.p: Greek seeds grower Spyrou Agriculture SA said in a statement its half year pretax earnings grew 24.1 percent to 1.44 billion drachmas from 1.16 billion a year earlier.
Over the same period, sales were up 21.8 percent to 4.88 billion drachmas compared to 4.01 billion in the first half of 1996. The management's turnover target for 1997 is 5.65 billion.
Spyrou Agriculture made its trading debut on the bourse's small-cap parallel market on Monday, July 28, after going public at 1,350 drachmas a share in June, its IPO subscribed over 40 times.
It tapped the market for 1.012 billion drachmas with an offering of 750,000 common bearer shares with a par value of 100 drachmas. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
